title: First Ever Royal Letter!
body:
To Her Royal Highness, Princess Guapa,

By order of the Great Kingdom and I, King Derek, this scroll has been crafted to remind you of your true power.

While this game has many levels and treasures, the greatest treasure is already here. Your heart is the rarest gem in the realm—full of kindness that lights up every room. I have watched you grow, and I am constantly amazed by how smart, creative, and wonderful you are!

Your Rank In My Heart: Best Daughter Ever!!!

Never forget that you are deeply loved by your biggest fan, which is me, King Derek. Now, go forth and conquer this kingdom!
